generated_for: Xanadu Surf Designs official named model catalog

brands.name: Xanadu Surf Designs
brands.short_description: Independent surfboard brand established in 1989 by shaper Xanadu, based at the Xanadu factory and showroom in Oceanside, California.

models.name: X11
models.description: The X11 is a high performance short board geared for power. With a lower entry rocker and a gradual tail rocker this board has an engine in it. The rocker contour combined with a little bit narrower nose outline allows the surfer to put a lot of weight on their front foot. It has a noticeably domed deck and a low rail to keep the board extremely precise. This board is no groveller. With single concave all the way from the front foot to the back of the tail this board keeps moving. Order this board in your standard shortboard size.

models.name: X14
models.description: To bring some new blood to the high performance line, Xanadu created the X14. With influences pulled from the X11 and the X21, the X14 takes it up a notch. Speed is not an issue with this monster. The middle allows for fast down-the-line drive, with a nose and tail rocker dialed in for quicker redirection up the face. The X14 is perfect for any lip or above lip ripping.

models.name: X20
models.description: The X-20 is for your intermediate to high performance surfer and made for waves that are up to head high. This board was designed to be a high performance work horse for W.Q.S surfers that are not always surfing in perfect conditions. This translates to a great board for all surfers in most conditions. It has a flatter entry and exit rocker and a single concave combined with a wider outline in the middle to flow in all conditions. This board is a mandatory part of the quiver unless you live somewhere where the waves are perfect everyday. RECOMMENDED SIZE: Order this one 2 inches shorter than your normal short board and about half an inch to 3/4 of an inch wider and you will be loving it.

models.name: X21
models.description: The X21 is a surfboard made for your intermediate to high performance surfer and made for waves that are waist high to over head. This board was designed to be a high performance surfboard for good waves at home, on the W.Q.S, and on the W.C.T. This board is one of Xanadu’s most popular models as it is one of the driviest short boards in our line. The X21 has a curvier entry rocker and a flatter exit rocker that creates massive amounts of speed and drive. This surfboard has heaps of single concave mixed with volume under the front foot that creates a virtual speed monster under your feet. When the WCT guys order boards this is quite often what they get. You would be surprised how many of them are on this board!

models.name: VIPER
models.description: The VIPER is a surfboard made for your intermediate to pro surfer who wants to excel in waves waist high to head high. Like the X21, this board was designed to be a mid wave performance surfboard for good waves at home, on the W.Q.S, and on the W.C.T. A major difference the Viper offers in comparison to the X21 is easier entry into waves, and MORE DRIVE. Same as the X21, the VIPER has heaps of single concave mixed with volume under the front foot. Xanadu dialed in some fine tweaks to make the VIPER the fastest board in the Xanadu Mid Wave Performance line.

models.name: SSTAR
models.description: The New for 2018 Xanadu ‘Sstar’ is derived from the popular high performance model, the X11. Differences are as follows: Low entry rocker, with most of the rocker focused 1/3 up from the tail. Small amount of vee in the nose, accentuated single concave in the middle and double concave in the tail. The Sstar is different than the X11 and other Family 3 Models in that it has a bit more rocker curve from the middle to the nose area. This will allow it to release easier in the nose area and help with added control in hollower waves. The Sstar has a medium dome deck and the rails are a little fuller than other Family 3 Models. If you like a little more volume in your performance models, this is a go to design. The Sstar has good floatation in the chest area making catching waves a breeze. The outline has bit more area in the nose and tail, which will help in smaller waves. The Sstar overall is a versatile performance model that will work great in most conditions worldwide.

models.name: KOZZ
models.description: The Kozz, is a very technical mid wave / high performance Xanadu model for 2017. This model has a low entry rocker and flat rocker on the stringer line to help maintain speed in mushy, fat waves and on the flat part of a wave. The rails have a good amount of curve to allow sharper turns in the hollower, steeper sections. The middle deck area does not have much dome, the domed area is accentuated in the area 1/3 up from the tail, where most of the rocker curve is. Since there isn’t much dome in the middle area of the deck, the rails are fuller in the this area. The Kozz has a good amount of volume, suited for surfers that prefer good floatation in the chest area for easier wave catching, and a turbo drive that is created in the middle to nose area of the bottom where the small vee to a deep single concave allows for a burst of speed out the gates.

models.name: KRATZ
models.description: The Kratz is a new high performance shortboard for 2014 that features a straight entry rocker built to perform great in point breaks with long walls.The Kratz will get great drive off the front foot down the line, and will work good on flatter faced waves. The Kratz also has a good amount of rocker and curve in the tail to allow for easy turns in the pocket. Basically, it’s a point killer.

models.name: VSTAR
models.description: VStar is designed to be the bigger wave version of the popular Moskah Model. The difference is found in the outline, where the nose and tail are narrower for better control in bigger waves. Otherwise the VStar has the same features of the Moskah. The details of the Moskah are: The Moskah, named after the ‘fly’, will have you buzzing around the line up, catching more waves than the next guy. The Moskah has a smooth nose rocker on the stringer line, which leads into a flatter rocker thru the tail, allowing for easy entry into waves and fluid drive down the line. The rail rocker has a bit more curve in the nose to release the board when transitioning up the face and into a turn. The Moskah is flatter between the middle to where the back foot is placed for optimum drive. There is more curve from your foot placement to the tail to allow for quick release of the tail when turning above and off the lip. The bottom contour starts with a flat vee in the nose, going into a single concave and flat bottom the last 3″ of the board. With a medium dome deck and rails, the outline of the Moskah is smooth, accentuating fluid and consistent lines in your surfing.

models.name: GP1
models.description: The GP1 features a low entry rocker similar to the X11, generating most of its speed from the front foot area to 20″ from the tail. The GP1 offers smooth S-turns on the face, critical control in the pocket, and flow through the flat sections.

models.name: VORK
models.description: The Vork is a great all around high performance short board. When designing the Vork, Xanadu kept the Xianz in mind but changed a few characteristics in the rail rocker to allow front footed surfers to get the most down the line drive possible out of their board, and to get speed from their bottom turns. Xanadu did this by lowering the rail rocker, thus giving the board a straighter and more drivey rocker that won’t push water. As if Xanadu’s boards didn’t have enough drive already??? The Vork could be the answer for the guy that wants to fly to the moon and back. With this straight but balanced entry curve the board will work good in all conditions and maintain it’s drive. This board has a noticeable domed deck with a medium rail for sensitivity. This board is a great paddler because it has a long gradual entry rocker, which also lets it keep its glide outside of the pocket. Don’t be mistaken, this board is about as high performance as it gets and you should be able to put it anywhere you want. This board is meant to be surfed radically in waves head high to over head. Available from 5’8″ to 6’4″.

models.name: ZANY
models.description: The ZANY is a great all around high performance short board. With a flatter more gradual entry rocker and a gradual over all rocker this board has a stable feel. This board feels ultra reliable making it ideal at point and reef set ups, or any waves that have down the line push. It features a flat bottom in the nose flowing into a ‘drivey’ single concave thru the middle all the way thru the fins. It then returns to flat for the last 3 inches of the tail to give it stability and control as you drive up and down the face. The Zany suits any style of surfer as the curves of the board have been toned down making it easy to surf, predictable, and responsive. This is a great board for the guy who wants something he can trust in a variety of conditions. Some of the feedback we have received so far is that it projects and draws continuous lines well, but still has insane pop in the pocket. Think down the line waves like Rincon or Snapper, or anything with some sideways push like Seaside Reef, and you may want to turn to the Zany. The Zany is meant to be surfed in waves shoulder high to over head.

models.name: Big 'G' 2
models.description: The BG-2 is is 3/4″ wider than its predecessor, has an overall straighter outline, fuller rails, and a bit of flatness in the nose and tail rockers, all adding up to maximum speed in small conditions. Combined with a wider nose and tail, the BG-2 will be a great board for guys over 190lbs looking to make it through flat, mushy sections with ease. And, to help increase wave count, Xanadu dialed in the entry rocker and nose width for easier paddling and wave entry.

models.name: XIANZ
models.description: The Xianz is a great all around high performance short board. With a pretty flat entry rocker and slightly wider nose outline it goes great in mush. This board has a noticeable domed deck with a medium rail for sensitivity. The first ten inches of the bottom are flat going into a single concave thru the fins with 3 inches of flat out the tail. This board is a great paddler and gets up and going quick. It also gets a lot of drive from the front foot for those who are front footed surfers and move around on thier board a lot. This board will be easy to paddle and will keep its glide. This board is meant to be surfed in waves head high to over head. Available from 5’4″ to 6’6″.

models.name: X15
models.description: The X15’s Vee to single concave gets most of the drive from 1/2 to front of the board, good release of the tail.

models.name: X19
models.description: Single to double concave, most of the drive comes from 1/2 to the tail of the board, double concave helps on the drive and the release of the tail because of the rocker feels really free in the front part of the board.

models.name: STRATOS
models.description: The Stratos was designed for intermediate to high performance surfers, for waves from waist heigh to overhead. It performs well on top to bottom turns and generates speed trough turns. This model has the wide point of the outline closer to the middle, and the nose is wider – this will help to catch waves and promotes better control trough the turns . Most of the single concave is on the center of the board fading out on the nose and tail, also to balance with the outline of the board.

models.name: PROTOSTAR
models.description: The PROTOSTAR is the latest addition to FAMILY 4, and it takes some characteristics of the ZANY, but has a wider nose for easier wave catching and surfing in smaller waves. The PROTOSTAR is built to perform in small waves to head high. Most of the area is forward from center. With less volume in the tail, the control from the tail is much more focused. Imagine flying through flat sections, but then when a fast section approaches, being able to control your manuevers with a high level of precision. The lateral and longitudal curves of the bottom were designed to give you heaps of drive down the line with better control through the turns. Great for beach breaks or broken up lines at a point break.

models.name: RR
models.description: The RR is a surfboard made for your intermediate to high performance surfer and made for waves that are waist high to over head. This board was designed to be a high performance surfboard for good waves at home, on the W.Q.S, and on the W.C.T. This model it is one of the driviest short boards in FAMILY ONE. The RR has a curvier entry rocker and a flatter exit rocker that creates massive amounts of speed and drive. This model has heaps of single concave mixed with volume under the front and back foot that creates a virtual speed monster under your feet, and it’s very easy to turn. Most our competitors have the RR model in their quiver.

models.name: X Up
models.description: The X-Up belongs to the Family One and because of that most of the release comes from the middle of the board, the nose rocker is very smooth to help get into the waves more so on a windy day, it also helps to get more drive from the front part of the board. The nose has little extra width and thickness to help catch waves, the tail is a little wider to help glide better and get more forward drive on the mushier, fat waves. On the bottom, the X-Up has a smooth vee on the nose area going to flat than concave and vee of the tail, the concave has smooth curves and not very deep to help change the rail, not tracking and sticking the board on the wave. Size of the waves that should perform best for this model is head high to double over head.

models.name: Nitz 2
models.description: The NITZ 2 came about at the request of all our loyal PIG 2 riders who wanted a PIG 2 that would translate to larger surf. The NITZ 2 is extremely versatile and performs well in larger waves shoulder high to 2 feet overhead. Think of it as a Pig 2 – Step Up for surfers that want a board that is easy to ride and paddle in when the surf gets bigger. The NITZ 2 features a rounder outline, but has a really pulled in pin tail allowing for tight arcing turns toward the lip, barrel riding, and getting into waves early. The foil, the rocker, the slightly harder rails, and the bottom contour result in a board that will be very easy to ride in larger surf. When Xanadu set out to make this board, his intention was to make a user friendly bigger wave board that would get in to waves. The result is a “step down” that bags pits and goes vert with ease. As far as sizing goes, the 5’11” has all ready been tested in double over head Lances Rights, and the 6’2″ has been tested in well double overhead Blacks, so don’t be afraid to order this board the same size as your short board. Just point it and charge.

models.name: MEGGA1
models.description: The MEGGA 1 is built for maximum speed in small conditions, excellent for driving through flat, mushy sections with ease. A bit of flatness in the nose and middle of the board rockers are what give this shape it’s added level of performance when you need it most. With a wider nose to make it easier to catch waves, the MEGGA 1 is great for guys 190lbs plus, and for those who are looking for a trusty every day board. The MEGGA 1 has ample volume overall. Xanadu designed the shape to have a good amount of foam on top of the rail which will improve wave catching, but the rest of the rail is foiled down nicely for better control through turns and fluid surfing down the line. The volume area from the middle to the bottom of the rail is low and refined. The bottom concaves were designed to create quick down the line speed, and controlled speed between turns using fine tuned hydrodynamic and fluid dynamics.

models.name: VEKX
models.description: The Vekx fits into two categories mainly due its versatility. It follows similar traits as the Piglet, Pig 2, Swift, Mithras and Nitz. The Pig 2, Piglet, Mithras, and the Swift are made for knee to shoulder high waves, the Nitz for overhead and bigger. The Vekx fits the void because it works best in waist to head high waves that are not super hollow, but have push. In these types of conditions, the Vekx will hold better than the Pig 2 because of it’s narrower tail, and will get into waves easier than the Nitz because it is wider from the middle to the nose. With a flatter deck and fuller rails, the Vekx has more volume overall. Probably one of our most versatile boards in the lineup – It will perform at your local break and your favorite destination.

models.name: X22
models.description: The X22 is a board you can trust when burying the rail into driving turns. Easy to turn, the X22 is able to get drive from all places on the wave, without catching a rail. With easy entry into waves, and good release off and above the lip, the X22 is considered one of the most versatile boards in the Xanadu Mid Wave Performance line for small, medium, and bigger surf.

models.name: MOSKAH
models.description: The Moskah, named after the ‘fly’, will have you buzzing around the line up, catching more waves than the next guy. The Moskah has a smooth nose rocker on the stringer line, which leads into a flatter rocker thru the tail, allowing for easy entry into waves and fluid drive down the line. The rail rocker has a bit more curve in the nose to release the board when transitioning up the face and into a turn. The Moskah is flatter between the middle to where the back foot is placed for optimum drive. There is more curve from your foot placement to the tail to allow for quick release of the tail when turning above and off the lip. The bottom contour starts with a flat vee in the nose, going into a single concave and flat bottom the last 3″ of the board. With a medium dome deck and rails, the outline of the Moskah is smooth, accentuating fluid and consistent lines in your surfing.

models.name: XPRESS
models.description: The Xpress is like a ticket to a Black Sabbath show. Expect a good time that you won’t want to end. Similar to the LYNX, yet quicker to turn, the Xpress is built to perform. The Express is in the lineage of the Mareh, Xank, and X20. Same size of wave and type of surfer. A flatter nose rocker / lower entry make this board excel in conditions you wouldn’t think possible. See you on the other side.

models.name: HYDRA
models.description: With the Hydra we have updated aspects of the long proven SW-15 model tweaking the rocker, and tweaking the outline to make it more futuristic, more relevant to now. The Hydra has a flatter entry rocker with a straighter outline, wider nose, wider tail to make up for the shorter length of the board. It also has a flatter deck which makes the rails fuller for added momentum over flat sections and creates a more “skatey and floaty” feel. This board goes fast, has incredible drive, and is meant to be easy to ride in small waves. Think of small days with a couple of flat spots where you might do the Huntington Hop, but still want to rip and don’t want to ride a fish, and this is where the Hydra comes into play. This board should be ridden 3″to 4″ shorter than a performance short board.

models.name: SW15
models.description: The SW-15 has become one of Xanadu’s small wave favorites. It has also become a favorite of bigger more powerful surfers in small waves. This board has a flatter entry rocker with a straighter outline, “wider nose, wider tail” to make up for the shorter length of the board. This board should be ridden 4″ shorter than a performance short board. It also has a flatter deck which makes the rails fuller for added momentum over flat sections and creates a more “skatey and floaty” feel. This board goes fast and has incredible drive. The tail has an exaggerated bump to loosen it up. It is available in the original squash tail and has been getting really popular as a wider swallow.

models.name: XANK
models.description: The Xank is like your every day good friend Hank. He might not be the best looking friend you have, but the ladies still seem to love him for some reason. Just like Hank is your trusty wing man, Xank will always come thru for you in all conditions. The Xank has a little bit fuller nose and tail and is meant to be ridden in up to shoulder high waves. It is recommended to ride this board 1 inch wider than your normal short board and two to four inches shorter. The Xank has a pretty smooth outline with flowing single concave. The tail outline is still aggressive but it has a wider tail block to flow thru flat spots and a flatter deck/ fuller rail combination to keep the board on top of the water in mushy waves. All aspects of Xanadu’s design really flow together well with this board.

models.name: X Quad
models.description: With a fuller nose and wider midpoint, this high performance quad gets into waves easily and flies down the line. The pulled in tail allows for more control and provides snap off the top. A great, all around performance board for a variety of conditions. If you love quads you will love this board. It comes standard as a swallow tail.

models.name: MAREH
models.description: The Mareh is one of our new high performance boards for 2012. With the recent success of the Xank on the WQS, Xanadu sought to tune it up a bit by making it slightly more high performance. The Mareh still features increased width under the chest while maintaining a narrow tail, but over all it is not quite as wide as the Xank. It also features an increased rocker, and fairly parallel outlines for a performance board. Essentially what Xanadu did with the Mareh is blend two very proven Xanadu models, the Xank and the X-16, and from the looks of it, it could be a marriage made in heaven. The Mareh like the Xank, will always come thru for you in all conditions. The Mareh has a little bit fuller chest area, but the nose, tail, and rocker are very high performance. This board is meant to be ridden in up to shoulder high waves. It is recommended to ride this board a 1/2 inch wider than your normal short board and two inches shorter. The Mareh really merges all aspects of Xanadu’s modern design theories into one board. This board is on the cutting edge of what is to come for all high performance boards in the future.

models.name: SW21
models.description: With a similar rocker than the X21, Xanadu made some changes on the rocker to perform better on smaller waves. On the outline the tail and nose is wider to make easier to catch waves (nose) and to perform on smaller waves with the same feeling as the X21 and it’s characteristics.

models.name: Sea Thunder
models.description: The Sea Thunder is the new twin fin from Family 1 for intermediate to experienced surfers who wants to do radical maneuvers on knee high up to head high waves. The foil of the board is more performance, has a little bit less foam on the nose and tail for more flex. The special aspect of this model is that the deck curve follows the bottom curve, so the water coming from the deck doesn’t fight with the water coming from the bottom (less drag = more speed). From the nose to tail the bottom starts with a roll vee going to a flat vee to a single concave in the middle to give drive through the turns, going to a flat and roll vee off the tail for sharp arc turns. The tail is a little narrower than our traditional fish but it’s still wide enough to help to glide on the mushy days and drive down the line. For that reason Xanadu puts his special vee on the tail. We strongly recommend you to ride this board with the Xanadu fins that can be purchased separately for a precise functionality.

models.name: MITHRAS
models.description: The Mithras is a tweaked mixture of Xanadu’s ever popular small wave hi – fi boards. The Mithras has been thoroughly tested and is well suited for airs. This board is loose, fast, and pretty squirrelly. It is meant for the most advanced trick based shred/air surfing. If you want to boost some ramps and land on fluffy whitewater clouds hop on this board! The Mithras has a little wider nose and tail to help on grovel days and to make it more forgiving. It also features Xanadu’s unmatched drive generating small wave rocker which will get you going mach. Pray to the sun god all summer long with the Mithras and you will be stoked. Just don’t shred the wax off your stick.

models.name: TWINTER
models.description: The Twinter was created to be a high performance Twin Fin for small waves that is fast and very loose. The bottom contour from the nose to tail is a roll vee to flat vee, to double concave vee and back to flat vee on the last 3″ of the tail. No much rocker from middle of the board to the tail to give a good drive down the line. This board has a little fuller outline and features a double winged swallow tail. The outline, combined with Xanadu’s special drive generating small wave rocker really makes this board go. Unlike the trendy old school twin fins that have been popular lately, this board is meant to be performance and modern surfing. Order this board as a twin fin only for small to head high waves and then be ready to fly.

models.name: FLASHBACK
models.description: The ‘FLASHBACK’ is a slightly refined version of Xanadu’s extremely popular boards from the late 1980’s. Guys on the tour in the 1980’s and early 1990’s were absolutely shredding the circuit on this model. If you want to party all night and surf all day just like the pro’s of the 80’s throw on your neon trunks, grab your flashback and your in there Rick. Consisting of fuller rails and a wider nose and tail, thus creating a straighter outline, this board goes super fast and creates a lot of down the line speed and drive. This historic performance model is .25″ – .5″ wider than the current short boards and the bottom has a light vee to double concave vee. Just think of the SW-15’s older step brother who still has a wave jelled into his hair and you have the ‘FLASHBACK’.

models.name: ZOGH
models.description: The Zógh is built for fun, flowy sessions in knee- to shoulder-high waves. Its rocker design delivers most of the down-the-line drive from the nose through the front two-thirds of the board, making it perfect for mushy, flatter conditions. The tail’s pronounced curve makes bottom-to-top turns smooth and responsive, with easy release at the lip. A lively, easy-going board for smaller surf that still lets you carve with confidence.

models.name: MOBY
models.description: The loose and fast Moby model is based on similar performance concepts offered in the infamous Pig 2 Model. With more area in the nose and a straighter rocker in the first 16 inches of the nose, the Moby makes it easier to get into waves, and straight into action. The middle part of the Moby utilizes more parallel lines to offer fluid drive from the front foot. If you drive heavy from the back foot, the flat tail rocker will get you flying lightning fast into turns off and above the lip. The Moby has a flatter deck, and boxier, wider tail. A definite go to board in small waves found worldwide. Order the Moby 2-4 inches shorter than your normal shortboard.

models.name: LYNX
models.description: The Lynx Model was created with the minds of Xanadu and Seaside local, Adam ‘Trout’ Traubman. Quick snaps in the pocket? The LYNX small wave performance board gets it done. This model has an accentuated low entry rocker and wide nose, which allows for quick entry into waves. Once in, you will feel the forward drive kick into gear. Quick directional turns will put in you the right spot at the right time. This board should be ridden 2″ to 3″ shorter than a performance short board.

models.name: PIGLET
models.description: The Piglet has finally been born, and with the new arrival there is a fair bit of excitement. When Xanadu made this board he genetically modified the Pig 2, and The Piglet was born with the same front end of the Pig 2, but a different rounder back end, and a slightly different rocker. Think of the Piglet as the Pig’s crazy brother that rips just as hard, and you’ve got the Piglet. Similar to the Pig, this board has a wider nose and tail, allowing for tight arcing turns in small pockets, and allowing the board to be ridden much smaller than a normal short board. This board also has a fair amount of nose rocker but fairly minimal tail rocker to keep the board going mach in small waves. Like it’s Pig 2 brother this board also has an indescribable small wave engine in it. Ride it as a tri fin, four fin, or get it with a five fin set up and get the smooth feeling of a small wave round tail machine that has to be ridden to see how fast this board really is.

models.name: SWIFT
models.description: The SWIFT is extremely versatile and performs well in almost any small waves. This board has a relatively curvy entry rocker for a small wave board, but it has a pretty flat tail rocker which ensures massive amounts of speed and drive. This proven small wave rocker ensures speed, maneuverability, and forgiveness that allows for hyper aggressive surfing in the pocket and above it. The Swift features an overall rounder outline with a round squash tail for added smoothness thru the turns. The Swift is a well rounded machine. It is very easy to surf, yet can still be surfed very aggressively allowing for airs and big tail wafts. The foil, the rocker, and the over all board contour allow for high performance surfing in small waves with this model. Its like cheating on your short board. At the very least, the Swift is a small wave high performance game changer, that is for sure!

models.name: ZIP
models.description: The ZIP was inspired by some of Xanadu’s small wave designs of the 80’s. With the ZIP we mixed some of the early 1980’s small wave board theory with what we have learned from the most recent small wave revolution. This resulted in a lower rocker wave catching machine. This board has a flatter deck with a fuller down rail. A bump is also incorporated into the outline to loosen the board up. This board is fun for down the line surfing in small surf. Think about long 80’s style floaters with speedy landings and the Zip is what you get. The ZIP features a flatter bottom into a slight double concave with exaggerated vee out the corners of the tail. The name for the new tail for the Zip is SQUALOW. This combined with an 80’s style rocker and outline produces a hip retro rocket. If you want to go fast, this is the board. The Zip should be surfed in waves from knee high to slightly overhead.

models.name: Pig 2
models.description: The ‘PIG 2’ is hands down one of Xanadu’s best small wave designs. It has stood the test of time and is here to stay. The ‘PIG 2’ is extremely versatile and performs well in almost any small waves. This board has a relatively curvy entry rocker for a small wave board, but it has a pretty flat tail rocker which ensures massive amounts of speed and drive. The ‘PIG 2’ features a rounder outline, “wider nose, wider tail” to make up for the shorter length of the board, allowing for tight arcing turns toward the lip. The foil, the rocker, the slightly harder rails, and the bottom contour have made this board magical and created a loyal ‘PIG 2’ following. Although made iconic with the moon tail people have also been riding it with a regular swallow tail, and most recently a diamond tail.

models.name: Mad X
models.description: The Mad-X model is a design derived from the mind of Xanadu late in the evening hours. The Mad-X model has less nose rocker than the HMB, a flat deck, and full rails for easy entry into waves and smooth transitions through flat spots. Order the Mad-X Model a bit smaller, similar to the size you would order a Gipos Model. The recommended wave size is knee high to head high. The size range of this board is 5’6″ to 6’10”.

models.name: GIO
models.description: New for 2014, the Gio is a fish that is similar to the Gipos, but with fuller rails and a flatter deck. The Gio keeps its speed, floats well and will still let you rip into turns with ease. The Gio is a great small wave groveler for average surf. Order this board with a swallow tail and a 4 fin setup. The Gio will have you zipping around in surf from 1 foot to head high.

models.name: HMB
models.description: The HMB surfboard model is a great shape for all skill levels. The HMB model has a really flat deck, full rails, and is made to catch waves easily. Jesse Wells and Michael “Squeely” Healy, two surfers from Encinitas, CA, designed this board alongside Xanadu. For a surfer improving in skill on a longboard or a fun board and is ready to step up to the intermediate level in shortboard riding, we recommend ordering the HMB Model a bit larger than your height. For a more experienced surfer, we recommend ordering the HMB Model a bit smaller, similar to the size you would order a Gipos Model. The recommended wave size is knee high to head high. The size range of this board is 5’6″ to 6’10”.

models.name: XBOX
models.description: The XBOX is all about having fun. This is a compact square little shred stick meant to go anywhere on a wave. Surprisingly maneuverable and carvy, this board is a great addition to a summer quiver. All ready tested and proven in down the line surf at Scorpion Bay, the XBOX is rumored to have made impossible sections. The straight rail lines allow for high speed trimming, but the overall compact nature of the board, and built in rail rocker allows for quick direction changes. When all is said and done this board is built to fly over flat spots faster than a bar of soap in a bathtub. This board should be ridden 6″ to 8″ shorter than a performance short board.

models.name: STUKA
models.description: The Stuka is a down and dirty performance fish. We needed a board in the line for small waves that had the grovel capability of the Gipos but was also more zippy and shreddable. Thus the Stuka was born. This board has a fairly round nose, and features a double winged swallow tail that is pulled in enough that it wont slide out. The outline, combined with Xanadu’s special drive generating small wave rocker really makes this board go. The Stuka has an aggressive double winged tail to loosen it up, but it will still surf smooth in and around the pocket. So far for 2012 the Stuka is probably one of the best all around boards in the line. Our goal with The Stuka was to create a board that planed and floated like the Gipos, but was a bit more high performance. The Stuka was created to be a high performance swallow tail with measurements that are a little narrower than the Gipos. If you are only going to buy one “fishy” board the Stuka will probably offer the most versatility.

models.name: OCTISQUID
models.description: The Octisquid comes from our ever growing family of Squid fish. These are some of the squirtiest, fastest fish on the market and are sure to throw crazy amounts of spray when on the sweet spot. The Octisquid is a super squirty fish that still offers a massive amount of turning ability and has that rolly rail to rail feeling of a round tail. This board can still be surfed vertically and can still slide above the lip. Don’t let her strange looks fool you, this board is insane and one of the funnest small wave boards on the market. The bottom features a single-to-double concave out the tail. The wings (or “stinger’s”) break the line of the rail to allow for better release when turning. Custom order tints are available. Fins are standard Xanadu squid fish fins. This board is a good mix for someone who wants to ride a fish, and is willing to master a new board shape!

models.name: SWAMI
models.description: The Swami was inspired by one of Xanadu’s most loyal team riders Hans Hagen. He came to us saying that we needed a board for small waves that had the shredability characteristics of the Pig 2 in small waves, but had the grovel capability of the Gipos. Thus the Swami was born. This board has a fairly round nose, and features a double winged specialty round squash that is pulled in enough that it will not slide out. The outline, combined with Xanadu’s special drive generating small wave rocker really makes this board go. The Swami looks smooth and transcends the best of both worlds. It is one of the best groveler boards that Xanadu has ever created.Our goal with The Swami was to create a board that planed and floated like the Gipos, but turned more aggressively like the Pig 2. Thus, the measurements fall right in between the Gipos and Pig 2.

models.name: NYDA
models.description: The Nyda is a super squirty four fin that still gives massive amount of turning ability. This board can still be surfed vertically and can still slide above the lip. The bottom features a single-to-double concave with light vee off the tips of the swallow tail. The wing (or “stinger”) breaks the line of the rail to allow for better release when turning. Custom order tints are available. Bigger four fin set ups work best with this board. This board is a good mix for someone who wants to ride a more old school style board but still wants to go straight up and turn in the pocket. Put this board on a rail and it will sail. Compared to the squid it has a narrower nose and a slightly more pulled in outline to make it more pockety. Ride this board from one foot to slightly over head.

models.name: GIPOS
models.description: ‘The Gipos’ has been getting rave reviews since day one. This board is a very sparky contemporary fish. ‘The Gipos’ has a very wide out line but is still ultra responsive. It keeps its speed, floats well and will still let you bang off big turns. Out of all the fish in our line this board surfs the most like a shortboard. Basically, what we did was add some characteristics of our shortboards into a compact, shorter, wider, and stubbier fish that is still able to go mach 10 and whip in the pocket.

models.name: SQUID
models.description: The Squid is a super squirty fish that still gives massive amount of turning ability. This board can still be surfed vertically and can still slide above the lip. The bottom features a single-to-double concave with light vee off the tips of the swallow tail. The wing (or “stinger”) breaks the line of the rail to allow for better release when turning. Custom order tints are available. Fins are standard Xanadu fish fins, with a touch more rake. This board is a good mix for someone who wants to ride a fish but still wants to go straight up and turn in the pocket.

models.name: HOBYO
models.description: The Hobyo is the perfect blend of old school funk and new school fun. The round nose makes this board easy to catch waves and to glide over flat spots, yet the rounder outline allows the board to draw more “down the line” turns. This outline with the “V” bottom to double concave makes for a smoother rail to rail action. This board looks a bit old school, but with Xanadu’s ultra current design incorporated into the board, the Hobyo will handle itself and perform well in a critical situation.

models.name: KATANA
models.description: This model is a performance fun board or mid length . The Katana have a domed deck, thin rail, curvy outline, not much foam on the nose and tail – all this combined helps on the flex, turning radius, easier to make vertical turns and better control on hollow waves . The rocker design on the Katana makes it easy to catch waves, good speed down the line and sharp turns . The fins on the side of the rail helps for the sharp turn and control on the maneuvers .

models.name: EZSLYD
models.description: The EZSLYD is a new style of glider – better performer glider with lots of down deck and thin rails to make easier to cut through the water and turn the board. Tear Drop outline make it easier to turn also. This model was designed to keep the surfer on the back half of the board. The side fins make easier sharp turns on bottom turns and on top of the waves.

models.name: Twin Z
models.description: The Twin Z was designed for waves with more power, waves that you have to race down the line to surf inside the barrel and have a good control inside and out of the barrel. The size of the board should be the same size as the surfer down to 4″ shorter – up to the surfer, what he or she likes to ride on size wise.

models.name: ZABOLT
models.description: The Zabolt is a modern take on the last generation of single fins from the late 1970’s. As a member of our Family 1, the rocker design features a nice entry curve toward the nose that allows for easy wave catching while giving good freedom through turns using the front part of the board. The low tail rocker provides control through turns and good drive down the line . The outline complements the rocker design. There is a good amount of planing area on under the front foot while from the middle to tail the width tapers down for control . The Zabolt was designed for waist to slightly overhead waves. It has a good width on the wide point of the board that will help to glide though the flat and mushy areas. The flatter deck and fuller, boxy rails help to catch waves. However, it has great drive and hold even in overhead surf making it a highly versatile board. You can order as a single fin or single fin side bite combination.

models.name: Wave Rocket
models.description: The Wave Rocket is BACK! This model was only available through a third party manufacturer since it’s conception, but now is being produced through our factory exclusively. The Wave Rocket is handmade in California, and is only available in EPS foam, with epoxy resin and X Glass. The Wave Rocket is similar in design to the Wave Rocket 2, only 3 differences are that the WR has a wider nose, wide point up a tad, and a little more foam for floatation in the tail. Get ready to blast off one of the most intergalactic fish models on the market.

models.name: TANGERINE
models.description: ‘Tangerine’ is built with a tail width similar to the Barrel Rider, but its much wider nose makes it easier to catch waves and will surf soft waves better than the Barrel Rider. Tangerine has a good amount of vee in the bottom contour making for a smooth ride and effortless changing from rail to rail. The narrower tail optimizes control in larger, stronger waves. The rail features a 30/70 ratio, allowing for smooth bottom and top turns. Tangerine is built to cut through chop, and will handle well on windy days.

models.name: Super Fly
models.description: The Super Fly is a twin fins made for waist to overhead waves. Although depending on the size and volume of the board, you can surf double overhead waves easily on the Super Fly. Good volume from the middle of the board to the nose makes for easy wave catching. From the middle of the board to the tail there is less volume and less area, optimizing control in powerful waves. The bottom is all vee bottom with a double concave in the tail area to give extra boost and drive through turns. We really recommend using Xanadu fins for the board.

models.name: Atomic Rocket
models.description: The Atomic Rocket is a fish that surfs good in small waves but was made to excel in chest to head high waves. In medium sized surf, you will have much better control of this board compared to a traditional fish. The Atomic Rocket will hold very well in hollow waves, something you may not expect until you set your rail and stall under the lip. Xanadu designed this little rocket with a bottom contour tuned to surf better in the pocket and in the barrel. The foil of the board, and the reverse tear drop outline makes it easier to get in to waves, which allows you to find your line early, setting yourself up for sections faster than you will expect. May take you a little bit to get used to the speedy Atomic Rocket, but once you do, the way you see waves will never be the same.

models.name: PONDSKIM
models.description: The Pondskim is one of our new Midlengths for 2013. This board features a relaxed old school rocker and is built for cruising. The outline has fairly parallel lines fading into a bold square tail. This board comes exclusively as a single fin and has rolly 50/50 rails tucked all the way back thru the tail. The Pondskim flows thru transitions pretty well making for a smooth glide.

models.name: RIDLEY
models.description: The Ridley mid-length is a shorter modern spin on 1960s style pig long board. It has a rolly bottom fading into vee out to the tail. This board features a unique template with a pulled in nose and most of the area featured around the hips. They come standard as a single fin square tail and are built to go fast. With fat hips like a 60s style pig and Xanadu’s special modern tweaks, this board can turn. Tested at Swamis and Malibu, you can feel this board flex and contort when on a rail. The Ridley may really surprise whoever is surfing it. The feedback we have received so far is that the board goes super fast with the lower overall rocker and is maneuverable. This board shares some of the same features of the Hawksbill, but is shorter and can be surfed with more agility. This board is recommended for all levels of surfing.

models.name: LEATHERBACK
models.description: The Leatherback is a great California cruzer. Seriously, there have been Sea Turtle sightings at Cardiff Reef again, so the Leatherback will fit right in. This board features a little bit wider over all out line with a wider tail block compared to a board like the Sumo. This provides a little bit more old school cruisy feel to the board. Perhaps the most “old school” of our longboards, the Leatherback is a blast.

models.name: Pipe Slider
models.description: This is Xanadu’s mid 1970s Pipeline inspired gun. It features straight lines that flow into an aggressively pulled in tail that will not slide out. The Pipe Sliders feature a flat panel vee bottom flowing into double concaves thru the tail. The Pipe Sliders mean business and are designed to go fast and smooth in the barrel. If you want to time travel back to the single fin era and slide into some pipes, this is the board. When comparing both single fin guns in our line up of boards, the Pipe Slider is for more critical waves whereas the Barrel Rider is better suited for all around surfing. The Pipe Slider is also thick and carries volume to the rail which is great for paddling.

models.name: LUTE
models.description: The Lute has the most volume of all our long board models. It features a little bit thicker rail than our other long board models and a bit less rocker making it smooth, cruisy, and easy to ride. This is a great nose rider featuring a concave nose flowing into rolled vee all the way out the tail. Think cruisy Cardiff Reef on a summer day and the Lute is probably the best shot.

models.name: LOGGERHEAD
models.description: The Loggerhead is Xanadu’s newest addition to our long board fleet. This board is a San Diego inspired cruiser. The Loggerhead has a very retro feel to it with cruisy gradual outlines and rocker. The overall conservative shape pulls in to a somewhat narrow pintail so you can really step on it and drive thru critical sections. The Loggerhead also features a flat bottom rolling into vee out the tail with 50/50 rails making for a classic rail to rail rolly feel. If you want to point it down the line and cruise faster than anyone else on a longboard, try the Loggerhead. This board is recommended for all levels of surfing.

models.name: HAWKSBILL
models.description: The Hawksbill long board is a modern spin on 1960’s style pig long boards. It has a rolly bottom fading into vee out to the tail. This board features a unique template with a pulled in nose and most of the area featured around the hips. They come standard as a single fin square tail and are built to go fast. With features of the 60’s style pigs and Xanadu’s special tweaks, this board is scary good! Tested at Swamis and Malibu, watch out for this fat little guy. This board is recommended for all levels of surfing.

models.name: Sli Dawg
models.description: The Sli Dawg model was created deep from with in the canyons of Laguna Beach in conjunction with some of Xanadu’s creative underground riders. When you want to go out to just have a blast this is the board. Its meant to be a high performance egg that can go from cruising to cranking right under your feet. This board features a fairly flowy flat over all rocker, with a template that fades into a wide round tail with a bump. Think any where from Malibu to Swamis on this board, or anywhere that is not going to throw you over the falls! This board can be ordered from 6’8″ to 8’6″.

models.name: SAMURAI
models.description: The Samurai is a high performance longboard meant to be surfed all over the wave. If you want to surf above the lip or under the lip this is the longboard of choice. This board has a more exaggerated rocker curve than the Sumo and comes standard with 60/40 rails. The Samurai board is recommended for all levels of surfing.

models.name: SUMO
models.description: The Sumo longboard is more of a traditional longboard in the sense that it draws classical rocker curves combined with a classical outline. The bottom consists of a single concave under the nose and rolled vee out to the tail. They come standard as a single fin and are great nose riders. Just like a Sumo you do not want to get in the way of this board. With 50/50 rails it carries steady momentum down the line with a balanced solid feel. This board is recommended for all levels of surfing.

models.name: NINJA
models.description: The NINJA like its namesake is a stealth operator that can take its enemy by surprise. It is a high performance pod meant to be surfed all over the wave. At first glance this board looks simple, but upon a closer look it elegantly blends retro lines with a modern rocker and bottom. This board is for the guy who wants to have the most fun on a pod style board, switching from knock knee retro cruising one minute to a modern roundhouse the next. This board can be surfed in all waves!! The NINJA board is recommended for all levels of surfing.

models.name: Wing Twin
models.description: The WINGTWIN is based on Xanadu’s late 70s twin fin template. The mixture of a 70’s outline combined with a post modern rocker design make this board magic. The board has a vee bottom flowing into double concave vee out the back. It works well for classic 70s twin fin style surfing and goes super fast down the line. After riding the WINGTWIN, your tri fin will feel like it drags seweed! This Twin fin feels so free and fast, get blasted to the past ! Let your hair down and ride a twin fin This board is a great representation of 70s era Twins. If you want to surf like M.R. or Cheyne Horan this might be the board to try it on. Expand your horizons and get groovy like your mom did.

models.name: Bonz X
models.description: The BONZX is for Xanadu aficionados. This board has a flatter entry rocker with a rounder outline, “wider nose, wider tail” to make up for the shorter length of the board. It should be ridden 6″ shorter than a performance shortboard. The BONZX also has a flatter deck but the rails are still pinched to grab on the face of the wave. At first glance you might not pay attention, but those in the know see a board that gets down the face early, pops under the lip with ease, and lets you get the barrel of your life. With long slanted side fins this board maintains incredible speed, hold, and drive. The board comes with a single fin box to allow for maximum customization and can be ridden with a bigger single fin.

models.name: Hot Dog
models.description: The HOTDOG is so hot right now. This is the hot diggity dog of the single fin world. In other words, this thing is super fun for all types of waves. From small California beach breaks, to Indo reef passes the Hotdog will do it. Like it’s namesake, this board is for hotdog single finning. This board has an extremely versatile rocker and outline and is just plain fun. Throw a nice 7.5 inch to 8 inch Tudor style Island fin on this retro diamond tail and it will fly. This board has a flatter entry rocker for easy paddling with a rounder outline that makes up for the shorter length of the board. We recommend ordering the HOTDOG with resin tints, opaque color, or even a sanded colored hot coat. This board should be ridden 6″ shorter than a performance shortboard. It also has a flatter deck which makes the rails fuller for more buoyancy for a better performance in smaller, flatter waves.

models.name: LOTUS
models.description: Essentially this is a classic fish with Xanadu’s unique cut away bump toward the tail. This gives the board a nice break and pivot point to loosen it up and make it swing around quicker. This board has been tested all over and rocks. Don’t let the cut away tail fool you, it just makes this board surf more radical! Like other San Diego inspired fish, this board is versatile as it is wide and sucks up a lot of wave energy. At the same time, the parallel rail lines allow the board to hold in in larger surf. Many people who order this board keep it in their quiver for life. Tested and approved from the beach breaks of O-side to the reefs of Cardiff, it is truly a flower amongst the overcrowded surfboard swamp! Custom order tints are available. The bottom contour of ‘The Lotus’ is a single to double concave. A flatter deck makes the rails fuller for more buoyancy for a better performance in smaller, flatter waves. Ride ‘The Lotus’ 8 inches shorter than a normal shortboard.

models.name: Barrel Rider
models.description: The Barrel Rider series of single fins are meant to be ridden in all waves. If you want to sit way out the back and paddle in all while sporting that sleek kink kneed retro style this is your series of board. They feature a flat panel vee bottom flowing into a double concave thru the tail. If El Niño lasts months on end and you are sick of riding your semi barrell rider and want to time travel back to the single fin era try one of our Barrel Rider Series with one of our many tail options. Suggestions are the swallow tail, the pin tail, the double wing pin tail or a fully custom one of a kind craft.

models.name: Semi Gun
models.description: Team tested in Puerto Escondido, Hawaii, Indonesia, Fiji, and California our newest semi gun provides speed and control when you need it. This design features a flat bottom funneling into a single concave that gradually goes pretty deep between the fins. Refined for this year, thickness and width have been shifted forward to make paddling and catching waves easier. From Bali to Mainland this board has been tested in tough conditions and is many a soul rangers favorite. This board is typically ordered with a round pin tail, 3 fins or 4. This board is for advanced surfers or anyone with the cojones large enough that want to charge and live their life in the tube.

models.name: G6
models.description: The G-6 is a serious board for large surf. If you want a gun in the 6’10”- 8’0″ range it would likely be the G-6 model from us. These boards feature a slightly fuller thickness for paddling but are still made to turn well, and hold in critical sections. The bottom contour features a slight double concave making this board ready to go in larger California, Mexican, and Hawaii surf. This board is an aggressive big wave machine, and has been taken to the limit in huge beach breaks and outer island reefs.

models.name: The Chase
models.description: Like its namesake The Chase is for chasing big waves. The Chase model is reserved for boards at least 8ft in size and can be shaped all the way up to 11ft. The Chase is for serious surfers only who are willing to paddle in and charge. They are built with extra thickness moved forward for paddling power, and are designed with the rocker and template curves necessary for big waves. They are available as 3 fins and very popular as 4 fins. These boards are specifically designed for Mainland Mexico, Waimea, Mavericks, and Todos Santos.

models.name: The Chase 2
models.description: Like its namesake The Chase is for chasing big waves. The Chase model is reserved for boards at least 8ft in size and can be shaped all the way up to 11ft. The Chase is for serious surfers only who are willing to paddle in and charge. They are built with extra thickness moved forward for paddling power, and are designed with the rocker and template curves necessary for big waves. They are available as 3 fins and very popular as 4 fins. These boards are specifically designed for Mainland Mexico, Waimea, Mavericks, and Todos Santos.

models.name: Step Off
models.description: The ‘Step Off’ board is a little wider and thicker than the ‘Tow In’, but it is still considerably smaller than a short board. A heavier higher density blank supported by a thicker stringer, gives the board strength and more importantly momentum in heavy conditions. A single concave bottom gives maneuverability, speed, and control in critical waves. The rocker is subtle and superb, and was designed to keep the board moving in the barrel while allowing it to stick to the face of any wave. This board has been tested by the best ‘Step Off’ group of surfers on the planet. Rest assured this is what they ride and has probably logged more barrel time in critical waves than any other board on the market. This board is most often ordered as a 4 fin moon tail with very heavy glassing however it is also used as a 3 fin. Ride this board in surf that is 8 to 20 feet.

models.name: Tow In
models.description: The ‘Tow-In’ board, which is narrower than the ‘Step-Off’ board, is designed for surf 20 ft. plus. A heavier, higher density blank, supported by a thicker stringer, gives the board strength, stability, and momentum in heavy conditions. This is a serious board and is used at places like Chopes, Jaws, and in Mainland Mexico. This board is the board of choice for guys like Brian Conley. The rocker and over all design of the board has resulted in a tow board that is fast, reliable, and stable on the face or in the barrel. This board is primarily ordered as a 4 fin moon tail, or a 3 fin moon tail with super heavy glassing.

models.name: XTOY
models.description: The X-TOY is modeled after the LYNX, a small wave high performance shortboard with a wider nose and an accentuated lower entry rocker. Because of these features, The X-Toy will allow for the groms to paddle in easier and quicker, allowing for more time to set up hits, flicks, and barrels down the line. Recommended for surfers 4 to 9 years old. Order 2″ to 3″ shorter than a performance short board.

models.name: Grom Pro
models.description: The Grom Pro is modeled after the X11 and X15 High Performance Shortboard Models. Starting with a lower entry rocker leading out to a gradual tail rocker, you can expect explosive speed into turns. The rocker contour mixed with a little bit narrow nose, domed deck, and a low rail keeps the board turning sharp and precise. Not meant for groveling in your local sloppy conditions… ride this board in good conditions where it will excel to your expectations. Order this board in your standard shortboard size.

models.name: K19
models.description: The K-19 is legendary. This is our fully customizable grommet board. More titles have been won on this lately in the NSSA than almost any other board. Surfers like Koa Smith and Ian Gentil swore by this board. There is nothing low tech about it. With an accentuated curve in the nose, the K-19 has the same classic Xanadu feel as the X21, but it is smoothed out for the surfers that don’t quite weigh as much. This model also features a lower tail rocker for added drive and speed since these sized boards all ready fit well in almost any sized pocket.
